--- title: "Module 10: Survey Sampling" subtitle: "Estimation with Stratified Random Sampling and Determining Sample Size" format: revealjs: # theme: simple # other modern-ish options: dark, simple, solarized theme: simple slide-number: c/t # chalkboard: true # lets you draw on top of slides (keyboard: c) or open a board (b) width: 1200 height: 675 css: modern-slides.css auto-stretch: false html-math-method: mathjax html-table-processing: none execute: warning: false message: false echo: true include-in-header: --- ::: {.cell} ::: # Estimation with Stratified Random Sampling ## Stratified Random Sampling ![](_images/10.2-stratified.png){width=60%} ## Notation for Stratified Random Sampling $N$: population size (number of sampling units in the population) $n$: sample size $L$: number of strata $N_{g}$: number of sampling units in stratum $g$ $n_{g}$: number of units **selected** from the $N_{g}$ sampling units in stratum $g$ (strata $g$'s sample size) ## Notation for Stratified Random Sampling $y_{gi}$: value of the $i^{th}$ unit in stratum $g$ **population parameters** $\mu_g$: population mean of stratum $g$ $\tau_g$: population total of stratum $g$ $\sigma^2_g$: population variance of stratum $g$ **sample statistics** $\bar{y}_g = \frac{1}{n_g}\sum_{i = 1}^{n_g} y_{gi}$: sample mean for stratum $g$ $s^2_g$: sample standard deviation of stratum $g$ ## Target Population Parameters $$ \begin{align} \tau &= \sum_{g=1}^L \sum_{i=1}^{N_g} y_{gi}\\ &= \sum_{g=1}^L \end{align} $$ $$ \begin{align} \mu &= \frac{1}{N}\tau\\ &= \frac{1}{N}\sum_{g=1}^L\qquad\mu_g \end{align} $$ ## Estimating the Population Mean with Stratified Random Sampling - Overall population mean: $\mu = \frac{1}{N}\cdot\tau$ - Overall population total: $\tau = \displaystyle\sum_{g = 1}^L \tau_g$ - Since the sample in each stratum is a SRS, we know that $\hat{\tau}_g = N_g\bar{y}_g$ is an unbiased estimator for $\tau_g$ - Therefore, an unbiased estimator ($\bar{y}_{st}$) for $\mu$ is: $\bar{y}_{st} = \frac{1}{N}\displaystyle\sum_{g = 1}^L$ ## Estimating the Population Mean with Stratified Random Sampling $$\bar{y}_{st} = \frac{1}{N}\displaystyle\sum_{g = 1}^L N_g\bar{y}_g$$ $$\hat{\mathbb{V}}[\bar{y}_{st}] = \frac{1}{N^2}\displaystyle\sum_{g = 1}^L N_g^2 \Big(1-\frac{n_g}{N_g}\Big)\Big(\frac{s_g^2}{n_g}\Big)$$ ## Estimating the Population Total with Stratified Random Sampling Therefore, an unbiased estimator for $\tau$ is: $$\hat{\tau}_{st} = N\bar{y}_{st} = \displaystyle\sum_{g = 1}^L N_g\bar{y}_g$$ And a reasonable estimated variance is: $$\hat{\mathbb{V}}[N\bar{y}_{st}] = N^2\hat{\mathbb{V}}[\bar{y}_{st}] = \displaystyle\sum_{g = 1}^L N_g^2 \Big(1-\frac{n_g}{N_g}\Big)\Big(\frac{s_g^2}{n_g}\Big)$$ ## Estimating Farm Acres -- Stratified Sampling ![](_images/10.2-stratified-sample-counties.png){width=60%} ## Estimating Farm Acres -- Stratified Sampling ::: {.cell} ::: :::columns :::column ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} table(agpop$region) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` NC NE S W 1054 220 1382 422 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} set.seed(343) agpop_strat <- agpop |> group_by(region) |> mutate(N_g = n()) |> slice_sample(prop = 300/3078) ``` ::: ::: :::column ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} agpop_strat |> group_by(region, N_g) |> summarize(n_g = n(), ybar_g = mean(acres92mil, na.rm = T), sd_g = sd(acres92mil, na.rm = T)) |> knitr::kable(digits = 3) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} |region | N_g| n_g| ybar_g| sd_g| |:------|----:|---:|------:|-----:| |NC | 1054| 102| 0.340| 0.280| |NE | 220| 21| 0.102| 0.092| |S | 1382| 134| 0.186| 0.230| |W | 422| 41| 0.705| 0.702| ::: ::: ::: ::: ## Estimating Mean and Total Farm Acres -- Stratified Sampling :::columns :::{.column width=60%} $\bar{y}_{st} = \frac{1}{N}\displaystyle\sum_{g = 1}^L N_g\bar{y}_g$




$\hat{\tau}_{st} = N\bar{y}_{st} =$ ::: :::{.column width=40%} ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} agpop_strat |> group_by(region, N_g) |> summarize(n_g = n(), ybar_g = mean(acres92mil, na.rm = T), sd_g = sd(acres92mil, na.rm = T)) |> knitr::kable(digits = 3) |> kableExtra::kable_styling(font_size = 25) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
region N_g n_g ybar_g sd_g
NC 1054 102 0.340 0.280
NE 220 21 0.102 0.092
S 1382 134 0.186 0.230
W 422 41 0.705 0.702
````` ::: ::: ::: ::: ## Estimating Variability of Estimated Farm Acres :::columns :::{.column width=60%} $\hat{\mathbb{V}}[\bar{y}_{st}] = \frac{1}{N^2}\displaystyle\sum_{g = 1}^L N_g^2 \Big(1-\frac{n_g}{N_g}\Big)\Big(\frac{s_g^2}{n_g}\Big)$




$\hat{\mathbb{V}}[\hat{\tau}_{st}] =$ ::: :::{.column width=40%} ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} agpop_strat |> group_by(region, N_g) |> summarize(n_g = n(), ybar_g = mean(acres92mil, na.rm = T), sd_g = sd(acres92mil, na.rm = T)) |> knitr::kable(digits = 3) |> kableExtra::kable_styling(font_size = 25) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}

NC 1054 102 0.340 0.280

````` ::: ::: ::: ::: ## Using `R` for Sampling Estimates - `survey` package ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(survey) ``` ::: **Step 1: Set Up Design** :::columns :::column **SRS** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} srs_des <- svydesign(id = ~1, data = agpopsrs, fpc = ~N, na_weights = "warn") ``` ::: ::: :::column **Stratified** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} strat_des <- svydesign(id = ~1, data = agpop_strat, strata = ~region, fpc = ~N_g, na_weights = "warn") ``` ::: ::: ::: ## Using `R` for Sampling Estimates - `survey` package **Step 2: Estimates** :::columns :::column **SRS** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # mean or prop svymean(~acres92mil, design = srs_des, na.rm = T) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` mean SE acres92mil 0.2937 0.0259 ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # total svytotal(~acres92mil, design = srs_des, na.rm = T) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` total SE acres92mil 897.95 79.17 ``` ::: ::: ::: :::column **Stratified** ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # mean or prop svymean(~acres92mil, design = strat_des, na.rm = T) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` mean SE acres92mil 0.30328 0.019 ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # total svytotal(~acres92mil, design = strat_des, na.rm = T) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` total SE acres92mil 927.24 58.297 ``` ::: ::: ::: ::: ## What if we used the wrong design for estimation? :::callout-warning ## Wrong analysis -- ignoring strata in estimation ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} incorrect_des <- svydesign(id = ~1, data = agpop_strat, fpc = ~N, na_weights = "warn") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # mean or prop svymean(~acres92mil, design = incorrect_des, na.rm = T) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` mean SE acres92mil 0.30359 0.0212 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # total svytotal(~acres92mil, design = incorrect_des, na.rm = T) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` total SE acres92mil 928.17 65.026 ``` ::: ::: ::: # Determining Sample Size ##
